title: Elige el mundo visual de Constancia
question: The roll assigned the Caracas modernist identity program. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Programa de identidad
options.lineage: Venezuelan modernist identity programs of the 1960s–70s (banks, museums, the Metro)
options.thesis: Constancia as an institution with an identity manual: one geometric mark, a strict grid, and the mark itself is the verifier.
options.viewport: A marigold block at left holds the mark, a C built from five segments; the headline sits at right on white, and a working drop slot sits below with the primary actions.
options.risk: If the grid is set timidly, it slides into generic Swiss minimalism.

raised.raise: Every check has a fixed position: its state changes in place, and the list never reorders.
Two values plus one colour: white, black, and marigold, with no decorative greys.
Every result prints its measured value beside it: hash, block, date.
On the Verified CV each job's length is its exact duration on a single axis.
One focal piece per screen; each transition announces itself.

options.label: Papel de seguridad
options.lineage: banknote and passport intaglio: guilloche, microtext, serials
options.thesis: Every certificate is printed like a security document: the guilloche resolves and the microtext reveals the real hash.
options.viewport: The page is a security sheet with a guilloche frame; the headline is set like a banknote's denomination, and the drop slot is the clear security window.
options.risk: The familiar 'official certificate' look; poorly executed, it reads as an NFT certificate or ornamental kitsch.

options.label: Instructivo de armado
options.thesis: Constancia explained like an assembly booklet: request, receive, share and verify as numbered steps with 1:1 call-outs.
options.viewport: Four huge numbered steps run across the page; the drop slot is the step-4 call-out, and the new piece of each step glows red.
options.case: It fuses cleanly, because the product is a sequence and the five checks are numbered steps. It wins on clarity but loses on trust: a bank can read it as a toy.
options.risk: Playful; to a consulate it can look like a toy rather than a credential.

options.label: Contador nixie
options.thesis: Every check as a tube bank that lights its digit.
options.viewport: Five tube banks with glowing digits.
options.case: It fuses poorly: dark with an orange glow reads as an instrument or crypto, not as a credential.
options.kept: Fixed positions: state changes in place.

options.label: Datamática
options.thesis: Hashes as fields of black-and-white bars.
options.viewport: A wall of bars and data columns.
options.case: It fuses poorly: exactly the 'artsy and unclear' look the user rejected.
options.kept: Total commitment to a minimal palette.

options.label: Forja
options.thesis: Every check as a hammer blow on hot iron.
options.viewport: A glowing bar with one blow per row.
options.case: It fuses poorly: industrial violence with no link to work letters.
options.kept: Each step registers its measured value.

options.label: Labanotación
options.thesis: A career as a vertical score.
options.case: It fuses poorly: an expert notation that no bank can read.
options.kept: Length equals exact duration on one axis.

options.label: Cartón de caricatura
options.thesis: Every screen as an episode card.
options.viewport: A starburst with an outlined logotype.
options.case: It fuses poorly: it destroys the trust the user asked for.

canonCard.label: El estándar de la categoría
canonCard.thesis: What identity-verification products ship, executed impeccably: white, slate, trust blue.
canonCard.viewport: A centred headline, an upload box and three benefit cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
